name: CanItEdit
description: A benchmark for evaluating code editing and code-to-code translation tasks. Tests models' ability to apply diffs, make targeted edits, and understand code transformations across different programming languages.
reputation: Specialized benchmark for code editing capabilities; useful for assessing models' fine-grained code manipulation skills
notes: Complements code generation benchmarks by focusing specifically on code modification and editing tasks rather than generation from scratch.
